productionFlags: Both normal deployments explicitly force ROOM_WAKE_ADAPTERS:0 and ROOM_ASSIGNMENT_DEADLINES:0, staging too. No relays/providers configured or enabled.
fixes: Fresh coalesced generation resets bounded retry eligibility without same-ID renewal.
Earliest coalescer retry participates in scheduler even when initial delivery rows drained.
Each bounded retry has distinct durable idempotency suffix; same attempt remains deduped.
Actual acknowledged signal IDs stop only matching latest generation and room; late old ack cannot stop new wake.
Assignments discovered from rooms even without Board claims; per-room v2 IDs honor same-room legacy replay only.
limits: Coalescer state is memory-only; no new durable host-wake guarantee or actual provider end-to-end proof.
Assignment feature remains disabled; its all-room discovery/hydration path is not qualified for production-size enablement.
Fake DNS/transport and injected times used for Node integration, not real wallclock provider latency.
